title: Queue markers: a temporary queue.<kind>.<pid> file is left when a waiter is SIGKILLed between opening and renaming its marker; mac-slot status can print a waiter that has just left, with a cat error; markers in the same second order by pid as text
evidence: tools/mac-slot.sh and ios/scripts/sim-run.sh open queue.* on fd 7 then rename it to waiting.*; nothing removes a stranded queue.* (harmless: nothing reads it, and a later same-pid process reuses it). mac-slot status probes then cats a marker the waiter may just have removed (cosmetic). sim-run markers are waiting.<epoch>.<pid>, so within one second 10000 sorts before 9999 (predates the queue). Reviews of PRs 1427 and 1428
